run_multi_turn_question_single: run the multi_turn_question function with two questions and retrieve the assistant answers
stream_multi_turn_question: stream the multi_turn_question output using state.text_iter with stream=True
batch_run_multi_turn_question: batch run the multi_turn_question function with multiple question pairs
set_default_vertexai_backend: set the default sgl backend to VertexAI with the gemini-pro model
define_sgl_function: define an sgl function with user and assistant message turns using the sgl.function decorator
